target: one existing approved dev environment; exact binding unresolved
repository_evaluation_acceptance: machine, using bound repository-evaluation/v1 predecessor checks
live_evaluation_acceptance: One human evidence review per BOLT, owned by existing V stories; agents execute all required UI/CLI/API checks, optional reviewer reruns.
expiry_rule: Resolve explicit UTC expiry at acceptance. Seven days is an initial engine execution window, not a delivery estimate; any extension is an explicit authorized revision of the same flow.
cost_boundary: Shared agent execution ceiling; separate infrastructure, Actions, provider/model calls and fixture limits must be bound before their live stage.
concurrency_rule: At most eight independent engine actions; serialize overlapping files and deployment to the shared target. B10 may build after B03; B06/B07 may build after B05.
deployment_boundary: Automatically deploy/observe reviewed main within the initially accepted dev target/workflow/policy scope when machine conditions pass. Reuse controller or eligible automatic runs; operations-worker protected-dispatch restrictions remain. Qualify automatic receipt-derived verification bindings before activation; no per-release human amendment.
registration_conditions: Owner authorized creation after review on 2026-10-19

activation_conditions: Bind the 11 repository machine evidence specifications to real provider/check/verifier identities; no human fallback
Deliver/qualify the bounded automatic verified-release handoff; reconcile its owner and budget
Bind actual dev environment, workflow/credential authority, repair scope and operations runtime evidence
Resolve runtime Project/catalog/executor/peer contracts and fixture availability for their dependent work
Refresh expiry if needed, preview the final revision, then obtain the single revision-bound initial acceptance
owner_confirmed_acceptance_approach: Humans review evidence of agent-executed UI/CLI journeys on existing verification stories; rerunning optional. Owner reviewed the proposal and authorized creation of this inert draft; activation remains separate.
code_review: Built-in engine development/review/repair/merge lifecycle; no separate review or assessment stories.
owner_confirmed_budget_and_concurrency: Owner selected a shared $2,000 flow budget and up to eight concurrent engine actions. These values must be carried into the bounded execution policy when the flow is created and accepted.
completion_rule: All 11 BOLT evidence evaluations accepted and parent criteria covered; roll up completion without a separate final human sign-off or closing whole peer epics.
public_copy: Sanitized historical policy intent; consult private flow records for accepted authority and current state.
